AMP_lifecycle: Four private scaler lanes per reference family, one per body index across ordered role seeds; no scaler shared between bodies/families, separate replay scaler.
TRAIN_diagnostics: Complement context only; VALID labels never prediction inputs.
all_costs: Full common preparation plus all24 body fits/selectors/checkpoints/replays and six assemblies. Each assembly/serialization is timed; cohort wall/CPU/cumulative RSS, fit/replay CUDA peaks and unique model/Adam/storage measured. Nested events must not be summed. Qualification is one update per body, not a full-fit cost.
assembly: Exactly four separately selected states, raw context logits mean within body then raw body logits mean; sigmoid>.5. No assembly candidate search or fitted vote.
body_dropout: Corresponding V3 member_rng_seed; independent owned stream.
generator_H: Exact V3 width32 context factory, generator base unchanged per role, _seed(base,body_index,site); corresponding candidate route H draws retained. U0/no biases.

native_horizon.selection: strict minimum complete VALID BCE, earliest ties
native_horizon.serving_precision: FP32; native AMP disabled for evaluation; VALID two contexts, TRAIN complement only

native_initialization: After frozen role/paired-cache preparation, native set_random_seed(role optimizer seed+1009*body index), fresh complete native CPU constructor and original placement. No deepcopy of shared candidate or predecessor fit.
ordinary_reference: Bare native SeHGNN, no point factors or context generators/masses. Same12 half-positive channels and both contexts.
own_selector: Each body strict minimum complete VALID BCE of its two-context raw-logit mean; earliest ties;200max/epoch-best_epoch>50. No common bank selector.
per_body_optimization: Native Adam .001/weight_decay0/default moments, own query-count-weighted paired BCE, each TRAIN target once, unscaled body gradient, two streamed half backward calls and one external step.
qualification: Optional separate root release: all eight complete one-update/replay body paths at first declared role, then assembled references. Existing complete V3/native input/runtime qualification is required; no repeated V3 qualification requested.
quality_claims: Development exploration on same encountered graph/roles. Not a pure tying intervention: independent initialization and own selection differ. No generalization, competence, novelty or efficiency claim from source.
same_information_reference: One factor-adapted native body per fit; six exact factor sites, two exact local multiplicative width32 generators; same positives/three masses/fifteen balances. No single128 substitute.

selected_replay.context_roster: TRAIN zero two-context members; VALID one body with both context logits; no zipped subset
selected_replay.floating_outputs: Max absolute drift <=.001 for pool/member/both VALID contexts/probability; zero prediction changes
selected_replay.full_state: Exact inherited full bank/buffers/Adam/scaler/master and member RNG restore

sharing: No trainable body/Adam/gradient/BN state across independently fitted bodies; read-only graph/feature/context inputs shared.
